Team —

Quick weekly check-in to align fleet provisioning with the top-of-pipe deals that are asking for Dedicated/Reserved slots over the next 60 days. Goal: make deterministic decisions on slot reservations, burst credits, and ticket prioritization so Finance can model committed spend and Infra can sequence provisioning tasks.

Key asks (please reply with the item number you own):
1) Confirm committed slot count per deal for April/May (Laura) — populate column D in the attached fleet-sprint-request.csv and drop any follow-ups in the Drive link below.
2) Flag any deals that need burst-only support vs reserved slots (Ben) — I want a short justification so we can map to burst credit buckets.
3) Marissa: if any SLA exceptions or early-burst approvals are required, note procurement or legal blockers.
4) Aditya: sanity-check revenue/close timing so Finance can finalize the month-end commit.

Attachments: fleet-sprint-request.csv (template) — also workbook on Drive: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1FleetRequestTemplate
JIRA: ticket SUP-1423 is the triage runbook we will use.

Proposed timeline:
- By EOD Wed: slots and burst asks populated in the CSV
- Thu morning: Infra triage; estimate turnaround for slot provisioning
- Fri: Final sign-off for slots that move to reserved capacity

If ACME confirms their pilot numbers this week we should plan to hold a 4-slot burst escrow for the pilot (their ask was preliminary). Emma, if you can confirm exact dates and procurement owner that helps us close the loop.

Thanks — short thread prefered here, but pull me into a stand if needed.

— Hiro
